note: Mission Implications rules. Wording is data: edit templates here without touching the engine. Condition grammar: {metric, op, value|ref} | {all:[...]} | {any:[...]} | {flag}. Template fields {name|format}; formats: h, pct, pct0, wh, w, deg, x1, m, met, int.

rules.title: Fidelity
rules.template: Terrain is not modelled for this site. Sun and Earth visibility come from geometry only, so they are optimistic: real terrain can only hide them more often.

rules.title: Landing in darkness
rules.template: At T+0 the Sun is hidden by terrain or the horizon: the lander arrives in darkness. First sunrise is at {rise|met}.

rules.title: Brownout
rules.template: With a {load|w} load and a {bat|wh} battery ({dod|pct0} usable), the battery reaches its depth-of-discharge floor at {t|met}.

rules.title: Storage
rules.template: The longest dark period is {gap|h}. At {load|w} this needs about {wh|wh} of usable storage ({bat|wh} installed).

rules.title: Comms gap
rules.template: Earth contact is lost for up to {gap|h}. Plan onboard data buffering and autonomy for that duration.

rules.title: No direct-to-Earth
rules.template: Earth never rises above {minEl|deg} (terrain plus minimum antenna elevation) during this mission. Direct-to-Earth contact is not possible; a relay would be required.

rules.title: Panel choice
rules.template: A vertical sun-tracking array yields about {x|x1}× the energy of a horizontal one at this site and date. The Sun averages only {el|deg} above the horizon.

rules.title: Long shadows
rules.template: With the Sun at {el|deg} on average, a 1 m rock casts a shadow about {len|m} long. Expect long hazard shadows for landing and traverse imaging.

rules.title: Time to sunset
rules.template: The first sunset after landing comes at {t|met}. Critical first-day activities should fit before it.

rules.title: Slip delta
rules.template: Moving from {A} to {B} changes sunlit time by {d|pp}; the largest change is in {metric}.
